subject: maths
question:
Arrange the following schemes in the ascending order of their discounts.

A. Buy 1 get 5 free

B. A single discount of 64%

C. Two successive discounts of 3% and 37%
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert all schemes into equivalent discount %

A: Buy 1 get 5 free ⇒ pay for 1 get 6 ⇒ discount = 5/6 = 83.33%

B: Direct discount = 64%

C: Successive ⇒ 3 + 37 − (3×37/100) = 40 − 1.11 = 38.89%

**∴ Ascending order = C [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A: Buy 1 get 5 free

B: 64% discount

C: 3% and 37% successive discounts

**Formula used:**

Successive discount = a + b − (ab/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ A: Buy 1 get 5 free ⇒ total items = 6

⇒ Discount = (5/6) × 100 = 83.33%

⇒ B: Discount = 64%

⇒ C: = 3 + 37 − (3×37/100)

⇒ = 40 − 1.11 = 38.89%

⇒ Compare: 38.89 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

Net discount = a + b − (ab/100)

Buy X Get Y Free

Effective discount = Y / (X + Y) × 100

Comparison Trick

Convert all offers into percentage form before comparing
